normal.text: This afternoon is all about cocktails, video games, and RELAXING! 🥃🎮 I'm kicking things off with an Old Pal cocktail and MechWarrior 5 (new to me!). Giant stompy exoskeletons , a good drink, and absolutely no work or writing on the agenda. 😂 How are you all spending your afternoon?

normal.name: ABAlex
normal.text: One of the weirdest things about kink is how being "forced" to do something relaxing can make it more effective. I WANT to play "embarrassing" regression games in cute outfits, it removes stress Being "forced" makes me want it more and removes more stress Hard to explain why but there ya go.

normal.name: Markus
normal.text: Free d6 table for a cozy winter journaling session. Who comes to your counter today? 1 the baker, curious about your letters 2 a bell-ringer counting days 3 bickering twins 4 an old snowplough driver 5 a fox on the sill 6 a stranger in grey, nameless Ad: from my advent game #journalingrpg #solorpg

normal.name: synergize your backwards overflow
normal.text: What game was a big part of your childhood? Spotted a used SaGa Frontier and its strategy guide when mom and I went to the Big City (Lincoln NE) and I was like 10. Had to have it. Fell in love instantly. It’s a comfort game for me, that I can start fresh anytime and feel at home.
